iteration.initialize: A = X.T @ X when X has more rows than columns; otherwise A = X @ X.T. Allocate B with the same shape as A.

steps.operation: B = a * (A @ A) + b * A + c * I
A = a * (B @ B) + b * A + c * I
B = a * (A @ A) + b * A + c * I
A = a * (B @ B) + b * A + c * I

iteration.finish: Y = X @ A when X has more rows than columns; otherwise Y = A @ X.
iteration.note: @ is matrix multiplication; I is the identity matrix. Read all operands before overwriting a buffer. All scaling and optional centering are already included in these coefficients.

verification: The lower endpoint is verified for the exact circuit. The upper endpoint and buffer ranges are verified when every stored value is multiplied by a rounding factor in [1/safety, safety]; this does not model every GPU rounding operation.
